**Windows:** download `StickOfTruth-SaveConverter.exe` and drag your JKSV/Checkpoint backup folder (or zip) onto it.
**Other systems / Steam Deck:** use the source code with Python 3.8+ (`python -m sot_save_converter --help`).

Before you start, read `docs/GUIDE.md` in the repository (Spanish: `docs/GUIDE.es.md`), and turn off Steam Cloud for the game before copying the converted saves.

What changed: see `CHANGELOG.md`.

> Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unsigned executable. If you prefer, run the Python version instead.
